memory: Michael is a 35-year-old freelance graphic designer from Seattle who is looking for a high-quality coffee machine that fits his design aesthetic. He has been researching our coffee machines and wants more details on both the standard drip coffee makers and espresso machines we offer.Michael's order has been delivered with a damaged espresso machine. The outer box has crushed corners and the top is slightly caved in. The machine itself has a significant dent on the right side, with sharp edges. Michael is concerned about the safety and functionality of the product.The espresso machine has additional damage beyond the dent on the stainless-steel body. The drip tray is out of place, and the steam wand is bent at an odd angle, not swiveling smoothly. Michael is concerned about the functionality and potential damage if he tries to straighten the steam wand.The stainless-steel frothing pitcher has a tiny scratch on the outside, but it seems to be in good condition otherwise. However, the main espresso unit has significant damage, including a dent on the stainless-steel body, a bent steam wand, and a misaligned water reservoir. The hinge also doesn't close flush. Michael is concerned about the potential electrical issues and water leaks due to the damage.
